items.text: Cleveland FINAL: QB Deshaun Watson (concussion) questionable, not cleared; HC Todd Monken says Shedeur Sanders starts (as the schedule lists). DT Maliek Collins (elbow/illness) OUT. LB Quincy Williams, RG Austin Barber, WR Denzel Boston, C Elgton Jenkins, DE Jared Verse cleared.
items.source: Yahoo Sports (Browns official Week 9 injury report)

items.text: New Orleans FINAL: RB CJ Donaldson (shoulder/concussion) OUT. Questionable - WR Jordyn Tyson (hamstring), OT Kelvin Banks Jr. (ankle), OT Asim Richards (thumb), CB Martin Emerson (shin). Tyler Shough starts.
